meta.title: 7 Days in Vietnam | Ultimate Vietnam Itinerary 2025 | Hanoi, Ha Long Bay, Hoi An & Ho Chi Minh City
meta.description:
Planning a 7 day trip to Vietnam? 🇻🇳 In this video, I share the perfect Vietnam itinerary covering the best destinations, top attractions, and must-try experiences across Hanoi, Ha Long Bay, Hoi An, and Ho Chi Minh City. Whether it’s your first time in Vietnam or you’re returning to explore more, this one-week travel plan is designed to help you make the most of your trip.

👉 Here’s what you’ll discover in this 7 Day Vietnam Itinerary:
✈️ Best way to start your trip in Hanoi (street food, Old Quarter, temples)
🚤 A magical cruise in Ha Long Bay
🏮 Exploring the lantern-lit streets of Hoi An Ancient Town
🌆 Vibrant culture, history, and nightlife in Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon)

✨ This video also covers:
Best time to visit Vietnam
Local transportation tips (trains, flights, buses)
Budget-friendly hacks & travel costs
Recommended tours and activities
Whether you’re into history, food, beaches, or culture, this Vietnam travel guide will help you plan the ultimate 7 days in Vietnam.
📌 Watch till the end for bonus tips on saving money and avoiding tourist traps!
#vietnamtravel #vietnamtravelguide #việtnam2025 #vietnamitinerary
